name: AMDA
summary: AMDA, also known as 9-aminomethyl-9,10-dihydroanthracene, is a tricyclic compound and cyclized phenethylamine which acts as a potent and selective antagonist for the 5-HT2A receptor (Ki = 20 nM). It has been used to help study the shape of the 5-HT2A protein, and develop a large family of related derivatives with even higher potency and/or selectivity.

pharmacology.text: AMDA, also known as 9-aminomethyl-9,10-dihydroanthracene, is a tricyclic compound and cyclized phenethylamine which acts as a potent and selective antagonist for the 5-HT2A receptor (Ki = 20 nM). As with AMDA, AMDH shows good affinity for the serotonin 5-HT2A receptor (Ki = 112 nM).
